articles.headline: Vincent Kompany dismisses talk of Bayern unrest amid Jamal Musiala controversy
articles.description: Bayern Munich head coach Vincent Kompany and sporting director Christoph Freund have stressed off-field issues are not a distraction and they remain focused on the upcoming match against Hamburg.

articles.headline: Joshua Kimmich blasts Bayern Munich over Jamal Musiala treatment: 'Absolute no-go'
articles.description: Bayern Munich midfielder Joshua Kimmich has launched a stinging attack on the club's "not Bayern-like" treatment of his teammate Jamal Musiala, who has a condition which causes seizures.
